name: Time capsule
summary: A drawn time capsule for the chat: each friend drops in one sealed prediction about someone else, the capsule gets buried under a flag with the dig date, and on dig day it comes back up so everyone can mark each prediction came true or not.
useWhen: where do you think we'll be in may
first night of junior year, predictions for the semester
let's write stuff to open at graduation
bet you'll still be single by spring, write it down
new year predictions for the group
dontUseWhen: a bet with a stake (use handshake-bet)
a reminder or countdown to an event (use countdown)
a recap of things that already happened (use wrapped)

question.description: The question from the chat, in their words

dig.description: Dig day as people say it, e.g. 'May 10'

digAt.description: Dig day as a timestamp in milliseconds; the capsule opens only after it

slips.description: Predictions already in: who wrote it, who it is about (someone else), and the prediction in their own words; kind, never mean
